title: I am a successful software dev but I have a serious drinking problem
guide_zh: 软件开发曾带来财富却被酗酒毁掉生活，作者坦陈问题并寻求改变。
author: user249
excerpt: I made a couple million and then lost it all, including the wife and kids. I muddle along now making enough to pay the rent. I don't want to end up like Phil Katz of pkzip fame, but I've come close. I don't know why I am posting this except as a cautionary tale -- stop drinking when you are young. Really. It doesn't get better.
